elements.text: Register the Adyen terminal used at a checkout. Use the target finder at the top to pick one checkout, because each checkout has its own terminal. A terminal ID set on a store, a group or the tenant would apply to every checkout below it, which you almost never want. The Adyen account details come from “Payments – Adyen cloud account”.

elements.label: How the payment reaches the terminal

elements.text: LOCAL_APP also needs the “Tap to Pay” section under “Payments – Adyen cloud account” to be filled in.
